description: This file defines the AssetRepair class for handling asset repair operations, including validation, stock management, accounting entries, and depreciation schedule adjustments within an ERP system.

classes.name: AssetRepair
classes.description: Class for managing asset repair processes, including validation, stock handling, accounting entries, and depreciation schedule modifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the asset repair document, updates status, and calculates total repair cost.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the asset based on repair status.

methods.name: set_total_value
methods.description: Calculates total value of stock items used in repair.

methods.name: calculate_total_repair_cost
methods.description: Calculates total repair cost including stock consumption.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Pre-submit hook to check repair status, update asset value, and handle depreciation.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Pre-cancel hook to revert asset value and depreciation adjustments.

methods.name: check_repair_status
methods.description: Ensures repair status is updated before proceeding.

methods.name: check_for_stock_items_and_warehouse
methods.description: Validates presence of stock items and warehouse information.

methods.name: increase_asset_value
methods.description: Increases asset value based on stock consumption and repair cost.

methods.name: decrease_asset_value
methods.description: Decreases asset value based on stock consumption and repair cost.

methods.name: get_total_value_of_stock_consumed
methods.description: Calculates total value of stock items consumed.

methods.name: decrease_stock_quantity
methods.description: Creates and submits stock entry to decrease stock quantities.

methods.name: increase_stock_quantity
methods.description: Cancels the stock entry to increase stock quantities.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for repair costs and stock consumption.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates GL entries for the repair transaction.

methods.name: modify_depreciation_schedule
methods.description: Adjusts depreciation schedule for asset after repair.

methods.name: calculate_last_schedule_date
methods.description: Calculates the last schedule date when increasing asset life.

methods.name: revert_depreciation_schedule_on_cancellation
methods.description: Reverts depreciation schedule changes upon cancellation.

methods.name: calculate_last_schedule_date_before_modification
methods.description: Calculates schedule date adjustments when reverting depreciation changes.
